method.baseline: Immutable git archive, with only trusted fixture TLS injection into the original sync function
method.fixture: Two fresh temporary stores; generated-certificate loopback IMAP; 50000 messages, 2100-byte repeated synthetic bodies, warm MODSEQ 10 checkpoints; UID 25000 changes read/star flags at MODSEQ 11
method.timing: Ends on both flags and providerSnapshot; seed time excluded; shared cloud host and concurrent validation can affect wall time
method.setup: Baseline observation predates setup memoization; incremental setup memoizes identical synthetic text and restores production functions before timing. This is not a seed-time performance comparison. The final runner uses the same memoized setup for both strategies.
method.limits: No polling intervals, WAN/throttling, cold caches, live accounts, native UI or large-burst/sparse-UID latency guarantee

baseline.scope: Warm synthetic cache/checkpoint, local TLS, debug build; excludes polling intervals, WAN, real accounts and native UI.

incremental.scope: Warm synthetic cache/checkpoint, local TLS, debug build; excludes polling intervals, WAN, real accounts and native UI.
